name: Alistar
title: The Minotaur

passive.name: Triumphant Roar

description.normalized: When Alistar takes damage, he heals himself for 27 and nearby allied champions for 54. Knocking up or stunning champions with Alistar's abilities reduces the cooldown by 10 seconds.

passive.rawParsedText: When Alistar takes damage, he heals himself for 27 and nearby allied champions for 54. Knocking up or stunning champions with Alistar's abilities reduces the cooldown by 10 seconds.

q.name: Pulverize

description.normalized: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air for 1 second.

q.rawParsedText: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air for 1 second.

w.name: Headbutt

description.normalized: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing 50 / 120 / 190 / 260 (+60% AP) magic damage and knocking the target back. May also target turrets to deal 75% damage.

w.rawParsedText: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing 50 / 120 / 190 / 260 (+60% AP) magic damage and knocking the target back. May also target turrets to deal 75% damage.

e.name: Trample

description.normalized: Deals 100 / 150 / 200 / 250 (+40% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies over 5 seconds. If Trample damages an enemy champion 5 times, Alistar's next attack within 5 seconds, againts an enemy champion, is empowered to deal an aditional 40 magic damage and stuns for 1 second. Only one stack can be gained per tick.

r.name: Unbreakable Will

description.normalized: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects and gain 55% / 65% / 75% damage reduction for 7 seconds.
